notes: Burrow (Hydrogen/Shopify-Oxygen headless, DTC furniture). Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (200s), no blocking; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. products.json endpoint is disabled (headless storefront), so no on-page 'X products' counter or JSON totalCount field is exposed anywhere -- the site's own product-listing pagination is cursor-based (Remix loader 'hasNextPage'/'endCursor', a 'Load more' button, no visible results count text). Verified exact qty via Playwright: loaded https://burrow.com/collections/best-sellers, counted unique base /products/ links inside <main> (excluding header/footer/mega-menu 'trending' previews, and stripping swatch query-string variants), then clicked 'Load more' repeatedly until the button disappeared (hasNextPage=false). Initial render = 25 unique products, +15 after one Load-more click = 40 total, button then gone. Checked full site sitemap (156 collection handles across sitemap/collections/1-2.xml) plus home-page nav dump for other bestseller-type terms (top sellers, most popular, customer favorites, trending) -- only one PLP found: /collections/best-sellers (H1 'Bestsellers', breadcrumb Home>Bestsellers, meta description 'Discover our best selling furniture and most popular pieces'). No genuine site-exposed sub-structure (e.g. 'Seating Bestsellers') exists -- it is a single undifferentiated listing spanning categories. Site is currently mid a sitewide 'Labor Day Sale' promo banner, unrelated to bestseller status.

rows.evidence: Playwright DOM count: unique /products/ base handles inside <main> (footer/nav excluded, swatch-variant query strings stripped) after exhausting 'Load more' pagination (Remix hasNextPage/endCursor cursor) = 40 (25 initial + 15 after 1 Load-more click; button absent thereafter). No on-page numeric counter exists on this headless storefront.
